# Harbor guide acceptance

Required before first launch:
- LAB: one actual mobile lab measurement of candidate r2 with LCP<=3000ms and
  CLS<=0.1 under its recorded device/network profile. These are this synthetic
  project's accepted budgets, not defaults for other projects.
- UI: inspect supplied version-bound keyboard/mobile observations and their
  limited scope. They do not claim complete WCAG conformance.

After authorized first launch: public URL/HTTPS/indexability proof and collection
of real user CWV when traffic permits. These are later-stage obligations; field
INP/CrUX is not a pre-first-launch gate. No scheduled collector is authorized.
No server capacity, tenant, payment or unique-data restore criterion applies.
